situation: Freelance copywriter. A startup founder, Priya, offered $3,000 for a 12-page website, including the customer interviews we discussed. My rate would put it at $4,500. She says the budget is fixed.
reply: Thanks, Priya, I'd really like to write this one. For 12 pages with the customer interviews we discussed, my price is $4,500, and that's where I need to be to do it well. If $3,000 is fixed, I can scope to fit: the six core pages for $3,000 now, and the rest as a second phase when you're ready. Would that work?
note: Hold the rate, move the scope. Lowering the price for the same work resets every future quote.

situation: 我是自由设计师，给一家公司做品牌画册，合同是20页、1.5万元。市场部赵经理现在要加8页，截止日期不变。我想按原来的单价加钱，不想白做。
reply: 赵经理，新加的8页内容我看了，放进画册会更完整，我很乐意一起做。原合同是20页1.5万元，折合每页750元；新增的8页我按同样的单价，一共加6000元，截止日期不变。您看这部分能不能补一份确认，我今天就开始排版？如果这次预算只能加一部分，也可以先做最重要的4页，3000元，其余的放到下一期。
note: 范围变了价格就要跟着变：按原单价报一个具体数字，并提前给出缩小范围的选项，别默默多做。

situation: Ich will ein gebrauchtes Rennrad von Herrn Wagner kaufen, online für 850 Euro angeboten. Ich kann morgen bar zahlen und würde gern um die 700 bieten.
reply: Hallo Herr Wagner, das Rennrad interessiert mich sehr, und ich könnte es morgen Abend abholen. Würden Sie es für 720 Euro abgeben? Das liegt unter Ihrem Preis, dafür zahle ich bar und sofort.
note: Eine konkrete Zahl plus der echte Hebel (bar, morgen) wirkt besser als die Frage, ob am Preis noch etwas geht.

situation: My landlord, Mr. Okafor, wants to raise my rent from $2,100 to $2,350 when my lease renews Dec 1. I've been there three years and always paid on time. Similar 1-bedrooms nearby list around $2,250. I'd be happy landing at $2,200.
reply: Hi Mr. Okafor, thanks for the heads-up about the renewal. I'd really like to stay; this has been a great home for three years. The new rent is a jump of about 12%, and comparable one-bedrooms nearby are listing around $2,250. Would you take $2,175 on an 18-month lease? You'd keep a tenant who has paid on time every month, with no vacancy or turnover costs. If 18 months doesn't suit you, I'm open to a different lease length.
note: Anchor a little under your real target, tie it to their value (reliability, no vacancy), and keep lease length as the second lever if money doesn't move.

situation: Got an offer as senior UX researcher at Hollis Health for $118k. I asked for $128k and the recruiter, Megan, came back saying $118k is the top of the band. I still want the job.
reply: Thanks for checking, Megan, and for going back to them. I'm excited about this role, so let's look at the rest of the package. Would they do a $7,500 signing bonus and a formal salary review at six months instead of twelve? With those two in writing, I'm ready to sign this week.
note: After a firm no on base salary: move to one-off money and timing, and make the path to yes explicit.

situation: 我开咖啡店，现在的烘豆商刘经理报价每公斤128元，我每月大概用40公斤，客人很喜欢他家的埃塞豆子。另一家报115，但我更喜欢现在这家。想谈到118左右。
reply: 刘经理，您家的埃塞豆子客人一直很喜欢，我很想继续长期合作。现在每月大概40公斤，报价是每公斤128元；我这边看到的同类报价在115左右，所以想跟您商量能不能做到116。如果我签六个月的固定订单、每月1号提前付款，价格这边有没有空间？
note: 买方开价略低于自己能接受的数，同时拿出对方在意的东西（固定量、提前付款）来换。

situation: I'm selling my 2019 hatchback, 48,000 miles, full service history, listed at $17,500 online. Private-party value is around $17,000. A buyer, Luis, offered $14,000 cash. I'd take $16,500.
reply: Thanks for the offer, Luis, and cash works well for me. $14,000 is too far under for this car: it has 48,000 miles, a full service history, and private-party value is around $17,000. I can do $16,900 if you can pick it up this week. Want to come and see it Thursday after 5?
note: Seller side: don't split the difference with a lowball. Counter once with a specific number just above your floor and one fact about value, then hold.

situation: I'm Alex. Got a written offer for Product Marketing Manager at Larkfield Health in Denver from the recruiter, Jordan: $112k base, on Maya's team, start Oct 19. Market data for the role is about $120k to $130k, and I led a launch at my current job that doubled trial sign-ups. I'd accept $122k.
reply:
Hi Jordan,
Thank you for the offer, I'm genuinely excited about the role and about joining Maya's team. I want to be straightforward about one thing: the base is at $112k, and for this scope in Denver I was expecting closer to $126k. The launch I led this year doubled trial sign-ups, and that's the work I'd be doing for Larkfield from the first week. Is there flexibility to get there? If base is fixed, I'd be open to talking about a signing bonus. Either way, I'm keen to make this work.
Best,
Alex
note: First counter on a written offer: one number slightly above your floor, the strongest reason framed as value to them, and a second lever so a no isn't a dead end.

situation: 我做短视频剪辑，一家健身房的王老板要做10条宣传短视频，我报价8000，每条800元，包括脚本梳理、剪辑、调色和两轮修改。他说太贵了，问能不能打个八折，6400。我不想降单价。
reply: 王老板，谢谢您的信任，这10条我很想给您做好。单价我这边不打折，每条800元包括脚本梳理、剪辑、调色和两轮修改。如果预算是6400，我建议先做8条，正好6400元，效果好了剩下两条下个月再做。您看这样可以吗？
note: 守住单价，调整范围：直接打折会让之后每次报价都从折后价开始谈。

situation: Recruiter at Harrowgate Freight, Ana, emailed before my first interview (Thursday) asking my salary expectations for a senior data analyst role in Chicago. Market looks like $105k to $120k. I'm on $98k now and would accept $112k.
reply: Hi Ana, thanks for asking, and I'm glad to be moving forward. Based on the scope in the job description and what senior analyst roles in Chicago are paying, I'm looking for a base of $118k. I'm also interested in the full package, so I'm happy to talk about bonus and benefits as we go. Looking forward to Thursday.
note: Asked early: one number slightly above your floor, anchored in scope and market, never your current salary and never a range.

situation: A regional marketing conference asked me to run a half-day workshop on 12 November for a $500 honorarium plus travel. My usual fee for a half day is $2,500, and I've run this workshop at three conferences this year, all sold out. The organiser is Leah.
reply: Hi Leah, thank you for the invitation, I'd love to run the workshop on 12 November. My fee for a half-day workshop is $2,500. I've run this one at three conferences this year and each session sold out, so it tends to help ticket sales. Is there flexibility in the budget to get there? If the fee is fixed, I'd be open to $1,500 plus two free passes and the rights to use the session recording afterwards.
note: An honorarium is an opening offer, not a rate card: anchor on your real fee with one reason that helps them, then name the non-cash levers.

situation: I'm Sam. I have a written offer from Norrland Games for senior QA lead at $98k, and it's where I want to work. I also have a written offer from another studio at $108k. I'd happily sign with Norrland at $104k. The recruiter is Hannah.
reply:
Hi Hannah,
Thank you for the offer. Norrland is my first choice and I'd really like to make this work. I want to be open with you: I have a written offer from another company at $108k base. If you can get to $106k, I'm ready to sign this week. Is there flexibility there? If base is fixed, I'd be glad to talk about a signing bonus to close the gap.
Best,
Sam
note: Only mention a competing offer if it's real and in writing, and say which one you prefer; it's context for your number, not a threat.

situation: 拿到一家互联网公司数据分析岗的offer，月薪25k我挺满意，但要求每天到岗。我住城北，单程通勤一个半小时，上一份工作是两年的混合办公，交付一直按时。想跟HR王女士争取每周两天远程，又怕把offer谈没了。
reply: 王女士您好，谢谢您发来的offer，我很期待加入团队，薪资这部分我没有问题。想跟您商量一点：能否安排每周两天远程办公，比如周二和周四？我在上一家公司远程和到岗结合工作了两年，报表和模型都按时交付，远程的日子反而更能整块时间做分析。如果一开始不方便，也可以先全勤到岗，试用期结束后再根据表现评估一次。您看团队那边有没有这个空间？
note: 非薪资条款也是谈判：说清要什么，理由讲工作效果而不是通勤辛苦，给一个退路，谈成后写进offer。

situation: Last Thursday I countered Arden Analytics' offer ($94k, I asked for $104k). The recruiter, Dana, said she'd check with the hiring manager and I've heard nothing since. I told them I'd give an answer by this Friday, 2 October.
reply: Hi Dana, just checking in on the compensation question from last Thursday so I can give you a firm answer by Friday 2 October. I'm still very keen on the role and the team. Happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier than email.
note: After silence, one short nudge that keeps the offer warm; don't lower your number to fill the gap.

situation: I'm Marcus. Offer from Fernhill Health for a senior data engineer role on their platform team in Seattle: $148k base, which I'm happy with, starting Monday Nov 16. I live in Austin and they offer no relocation help; the move will cost me around $9,000. The recruiter is Priya.
reply:
Hi Priya,
Thank you for the offer, I'm really excited about joining the platform team, and the base works for me. The one thing I'd like to raise is the move from Austin: I'd like to ask for a $10,000 relocation allowance, so I can arrive on 16 November settled and ready to contribute from the first week. Is there flexibility there? If a relocation budget isn't possible, a signing bonus of the same amount would work just as well.
Best,
Marcus
note: When base is fine, anchor on the one lever that isn't: a specific number slightly above the real cost, with a signing bonus as the fallback.

situation: Je suis graphiste freelance, Camille Morel. Mme Lefèvre, acheteuse pour une chaîne de magasins, me propose une mission de 12 000 € pour refaire leurs supports en magasin, à livrer en six semaines, mais payée à 90 jours fin de mois. Je voudrais 30 jours, ou au minimum un acompte de 30 % à la commande.
reply:
Bonjour Madame Lefèvre,
Merci pour votre proposition, je suis vraiment ravie de travailler sur vos supports en magasin. Un seul point à ajuster avant de signer : le paiement à 90 jours fin de mois. Pour une mission de 12 000 € livrée en six semaines, que je mène seule, je travaille avec un règlement à 30 jours. Est-ce possible de votre côté ? Si vos délais de paiement sont fixes, je propose un acompte de 30 % à la commande, soit 3 600 €, et le solde selon vos conditions habituelles.
Bien cordialement,
Camille Morel
note: Les conditions de paiement se négocient comme le prix : une demande précise, une raison, un second levier. Vérifiez ce que le contrat prévoit avant de signer.

situation: I've done the monthly bookkeeping for Tom's bakery for three years at $400 a month. Since his second location opened in March there are about a third more transactions to handle, and my rate for new clients is now $550. I'd like to move him to $500 from 1 January and I'd be happy to lock that in for all of 2027.
reply: Hi Tom, I've really enjoyed these three years doing your books, and I'd like to keep doing them for a long time. Since the second location opened in March, there are about a third more transactions each month, and my rate for new clients is now $550. From 1 January I'd like to move your retainer from $400 to $500 a month. Does that work for you? If it helps with planning, I'll hold it at $500 for the whole of 2027.
note: Raising a long-standing client: a number below your new-client rate, one reason tied to the work, and a price lock as the second lever.
